privacyBody: This local demonstration uses fictional property inventory and demo accounts. Preferences, consent, shortlists, viewing requests and conversations are stored in the configured database. You may delete conversation history or your account at any time. Do not upload real identity documents. External AI is disabled by default; enabling it sends your message and brief to the configured provider. Data region configuration expresses deployment intent and does not itself guarantee residency. Legal review is required before launch.
